items.source: Determine the keySpace to use for a given type.
items.translation: 确定给定类型应使用的密钥空间。

items.source: AnnotationBasedKeySpaceResolver looks up Persistent and checks for presence of either meta or direct usage of KeySpace. If non found it will default the keyspace to Class.getName().
items.translation: `AnnotationBasedKeySpaceResolver` 会查找 Persistent，并检查是否存在对 KeySpace 的元数据使用或直接使用。如果未找到，则默认将 keyspace 设置为 Class.getName()。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）
